digest.component_or_area: build-provenance fixtures and artifact probe workflow
propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures export 3,019 checkout files when production hatch_build.py requires only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py, causing repeated redundant builds across xdist workers
Artifact probe builds with workflow GITHUB_SHA instead of final checkout HEAD, causing wrong SHA to pass truthiness probes and violate exact-source identity contract
Cross-platform build semantics tests execute redundant isolated sdist-to-wheel builds in every OS/Python cell instead of reusing a minimal shared fixture
Xdist session fixture initializes independently on three workers, with each paying 6.60-6.74s setup overhead for duplicate builds
Artifact probe requires truthiness-only assertions on wheel and sdist rather than exact SHA equality after final checkout
